//: Deliberate escape hatch, not a version contract. The repository root pins .NET SDK 10.0.301 with rollForward disable so builds are reproducible; a machine with only a later 10.0.x cannot run dotnet at all from the root. Running dotnet from THIS directory rolls forward to whatever 10.0.x is installed, which is enough for the platform-neutral test project. Never use it to build or package a release: those must go through the root pin. See the Build section of README.md.
